description: This file defines the 'Pool' class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, which manages concurrent HTTP requests using a request pool with configurable concurrency. It includes methods for constructing the pool, retrieving a promise, executing batch requests, and handling callbacks.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of HTTP requests to be sent concurrently with a maximum concurrency limit, providing methods for batch processing and promise handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pool with a client, requests (or request-generating functions), and configuration options, setting up the request iterator and promise handling.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the promise associated with the request pool, allowing callers to wait for all requests to complete.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes multiple requests concurrently, returning an array of responses or exceptions in the order of requests.

methods.name: cmpCallback
methods.description: Helper method to set or augment callback functions for fulfilled and rejected request handling, updating the results array accordingly.
